cards.back: A closed flat shape made of straight sides.
Always the same distance apart; never meet.
Meeting to form a right angle.
An angle of exactly 90°.
Acute: less than 90°. Obtuse: greater than 90°.
3 equal sides / exactly 2 equal sides / no equal sides.
A polygon with 4 sides.
A quadrilateral with 2 pairs of parallel sides.
A parallelogram with 4 equal sides.
An organized chart where each group belongs to the group above it.
Yes. A square has 4 right angles, so it is a rectangle.
No. A rectangle’s sides do not have to be equal.

cards.front: What do tick marks on sides mean?
cards.back: Sides with the same number of tick marks are equal.

cards.front: What do arrow marks on sides mean?
cards.back: Sides with matching arrows are parallel.

cards.front: What does a small square in a corner mean?
cards.back: A right angle (90°).

cards.front: A triangle has a 100° angle. What kind is it?
cards.back: Obtuse
Rectangles, rhombuses and squares.

cards.front: If all rectangles have 4 right angles and squares are rectangles, then…
cards.back: all squares have 4 right angles.
Rhombus: 4 equal sides, 2 pairs of parallel sides.
